lines.text: Tonight while you sleep peacefully, your brain will open a magical 3D movie theater!
You might fly over skyscrapers or chat with talking purple puppies!
Why does your brain create wild, colorful stories while your body is completely asleep?
Deep in sleep, you enter a special stage called REM—Rapid Eye Movement!
Your brain acts like a busy librarian, sorting through every memory from your day!
It files away the math you learned and the funny joke your friend told!
As memories weave together, your imagination sparks, painting dreams across your mind!
Good sleep organizes your brain so you wake up sharp, happy, and energized!
Dream big every night—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
